newsitem.title: SPAIN: Central banks should hold fire on EMU - Spain banks.
newsitem.headline: Central banks should hold fire on EMU - Spain banks.

text.p: European central bankers should tone down their language and refrain from remarks about other countries' ability to meet Maastricht EMU criteria, Spanish private banking association chairman Jose Luis Leal said on Wednesday.

"It'd be convenient if central banks talked among themselves with a less exuberant attitude towards other countries' ability to meet (European economic and monetary union convergence) criteria," he told reporters.
He reiterated that Spain will be among the founding members of the European single currency.
"EMU will happen; there will be a few nervous breakdowns... but it will be clear that our economy is ready to enter," he said. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
